    {

  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:6542871465",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Apply the same exception-handling logic and urgent-data disconnect test to HTTP in httpserver.cpp",
      "quote": "Mine as well apply the same logic to HTTP, probably right here",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented the HTTP fix and expanded tests",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6555092908",
        "c:6635339551"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6635339551",
      "status_by_quote": "Finally, I added the http fix at the end."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5745118254",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Always fail on error or exception during a wait rather than ignoring it outside Windows",
      "quote": "i prefer @theuni's suggestion to just always fail on error/exception during a wait",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],

    {
      "id": "r:5745118254",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "What is the rationale or point of the second commit?",
      "quote": "I don't understand the point of the second commit.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4444657556",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Put FD_ISSET check inside #ifdef WIN32 if handling select error events is a no-op on non-Windows",
      "quote": "If yes, then consider also putting it inside `#ifdef WIN32` to make that more clear.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added a commit wrapping the check in #ifdef WIN32",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4467001547",
        "c:6635339551"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4467001547",
      "status_by_quote": "Added a commit for this."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4444703434",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Should the recvSet || errorSet condition be revised or the #ifdef WIN32 removed since errorSet is only populated on Windows?",
      "quote": "Should the below `if (recvSet || errorSet)` be revised as well?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied and added a commit checking errorSet separately and earlier for poll()",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4468366950",
        "c:6635339551"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4468366950",
      "status_by_quote": "I added a commit to check `errorSet` separately and earlier, for `poll()`."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4449209051",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Drop the confusing comment added regarding RFC 6093 and SO_OOBINLINE",
      "quote": "i think that comment just adds more confusion than it clears up, and it would be better to drop it.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author dropped the comment-only commit",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4465274607",
        "c:6635339551"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6635339551",
      "status_by_quote": "I dropped the comment-only commit."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6673573479",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Consider OOB data an error condition and disconnect or ban the peer",
      "quote": "I strongly suggest that oob data be considered an error condition based on this.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that errorSet could be triggered for unrelated OS reasons and disconnect a well-behaved peer",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6680874189"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6680874189",
      "status_by_quote": "All we can know is that `errorSet` was triggered, which could be for unrelated OS reasons. That could cause us to discon"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6696077887",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Always disconnect when an exception is set or OOB/priority data is found across all platforms without platform-specific behavior",
      "quote": "Imo we should just always disconnect when an exception is set, or when oob/prio are found. I don't see any need for platform-specific behavior here.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "theuni retracted the suggestion after finding that aligning behaviors across platforms requires logical hacks",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6739652398"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6925017494",
      "status_by_quote": "Ok, I retract the above. After experimenting for the last few days, nothing really works here to align the two behaviors"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6931290348",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Isolate the connection failure use-case for the select error set rather than isolating platforms that require it",
      "quote": "Rather than trying to isolate the platforms that require that use-case, why not isolate the use-case instead?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author adopted the suggestion and theuni gave an Approach ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6986474295"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:5966316401",
      "status_by_quote": "Approach ACK, thanks for the update."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4622012073",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Skipping errorSet in the poll check could wake for a lone POLLHUP event without handling it, causing a tight loop",
      "quote": "I think if we skip the || errorSet here, we could end up waking for the error (POLLHUP) event, and never doing anything with it. Then we're back to the tight loop.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author dropped the change removing errorSet and explained the poll error handling",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4627065919"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4627065919",
      "status_by_quote": "I still dropped this change: 67bdc2d3b5c62dd4d8cf0eb757b78fcf0d5b56b3 -> 8b8a2f49267daa6a3f9d85d9cb511bd7c286e52a"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4633415573",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Why does the Sock event/flag bitmask jump from (1 << 2) to (1 << 4)?",
      "quote": "Why the jump from (1 << 2) to (1 << 4)?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "theuni explained that the lower half is reserved for events and the upper half for flags",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:4635863098"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4635863098",
      "status_by_quote": "Just keeping the low half reserved for Events and the high for Flags."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4635778316",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The new functional test demonstrates progress on urgent data rather than testing the socket error bug the PR sets out to fix",
      "quote": "the bug you are trying to fix in this PR is not a lack of progress on urgent data",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5984214102",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Return to the simple approach of always disconnecting when a wait returns an ErrorEvent to keep the fix minimal and safe to backport",
      "quote": "Why not go back to the simple approach of simply always disconnecting when a wait returns an `ErrorEvent`? It's short, easy to reason about and safer to backport.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5984214102",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "The added functional tests are brittle because they rely on machine-specific kernel settings and may break on CI updates without catching the targeted bug",
      "quote": "this PR adds a whole bunch of functional tests that seem pretty brittle to me, since they rely on kernel settings that may differ between machines, or break when we update CI",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5745118254",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "fixes the issue in P2P",

      "reason": "at the very least deleting exceptfds from the select() call is needed to avoid looping on unreceived OOB urgent data",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5966316401",
      "verdict": "Approach ACK",
      "reason": "updated approach isolating the connection use-case looks good",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Sjors addressed theuni's tight loop objection by dropping the removal of errorSet. Darosior questioned the bitmask jump (answered by theuni) and objected to the grown scope and brittle functional tests, recommending a simpler approach.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "response to darosior's review questioning the grown scope, brittle tests, and suggesting a simpler approach",
